item.title:
Your reply still doesn’t touch a single point in the post. It completely sidesteps the question: why is there no cry of “Hinduphobia” in the Kharat case, but the TCS Nashik case instantly gets reframed as “Islamophobia” and community victimhood the moment Muslim accused are involved.

When you say “all predators are bad” in that context, you’re not being neutral; you’re quietly giving Islam a soft shield. You blur a very specific pattern of grooming and forced conversion into a vague “everyone is equally bad” line so you never have to name what’s actually happening.

 It’s classic whataboutery: bring up another horror, say “see, it’s all the same”, and keep dodging the one pattern you’re clearly uncomfortable calling out.

VERY VERY DISHONEST and manipulative.
